label.zh: 之后与蒂扬奇完成初次接触时补发
label.en: Sent later, when first contact with the Tiyanki is completed

bridges.evidence: common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:178 (finish_first_contact_effect: if has_country_flag = tiyanki_graveyard_survey fires galactic_features.387); 384 starts the first-contact process via random_active_first_contact (events/galactic_features_events.txt:3758-3760)

label.zh: 勘测后：有无与蒂扬奇的通讯
label.en: After the survey: with or without contact with the Tiyanki

note.zh: 勘测完成后若已与蒂扬奇（或其守卫）有通讯则出现 387，否则出现 384“神秘的守卫”，之后初次接触等才会补上后续。
note.en: After the survey 387 appears if the empire can talk to the Tiyanki (or their guardians), otherwise 384 "Mysterious Guardians", with the follow-up coming later through first contact.

note.zh: 消灭守墓者（388）或用诱饵把它们引开（专项 → 389），两者都会设下全局旗标 tiyanki_graveyard_access 并结束事件链。
note.en: Destroy the gravekeepers (388) or lure them away (project -> 389); both set the global flag tiyanki_graveyard_access and end the event chain.

notes.zh: 评注：勘测墓地行星（标记 graveyard_site）时，首个人类玩家会设下 tiyanki_graveyard_survey；有通讯则本窗口，无通讯则隐藏事件 galactic_features.386 发 384（events/galactic_features_events.txt:3555-3590）。
notes.en: Commentary: when the graveyard planet (flag graveyard_site) is surveyed the first human player sets tiyanki_graveyard_survey; with communications this window shows, otherwise the hidden galactic_features.386 sends 384 (events/galactic_features_events.txt:3555-3590).

notes.zh: 评注：当守墓舰队被歼灭（on_fleet_destroyed_perp）且尚无人取得进入权时触发（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1665）。
notes.en: Commentary: fires when the gravekeeper fleet is destroyed (on_fleet_destroyed_perp) and nobody has gained access yet (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1665).

scope.zh: 勘测入口、通讯分支、杀与诱两条路线、结束旗标均已核对；墓地考古内容属其他故事。
scope.en: The survey entrance, the communication branch, the kill / lure routes and the closing flag were checked; the graveyard archaeology belongs to other stories.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that star system appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现缇扬奇坟场所在星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the Tiyanki graveyard system appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现尚未接触的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species not yet contacted appears here.
